description: Five-alpha portfolio all PASSING WQ submission gate (LOW_SHARPE, LOW_FITNESS, LOW_TURNOVER, HIGH_TURNOVER, CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT, LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE all PASS).
cluster_structure: Only 3 truly distinct IV mechanisms exist as PASS clusters on this account: (1) PCR ratio momentum, (2) long-horizon skew differential, (3) term-structure with light skew weighting. Within-cluster correlations are 0.85-0.99; cross-cluster 0.26-0.67.
caveat: Submitting all 5 to WQ would trigger SELF_CORRELATION rejection on within-cluster pairs (Sk_h720<->LongStack 0.952; Mix_70_30<->Mix_60_40 0.961). For submission, choose AT MOST one per cluster -> 3 alpha submissions max.

factors.economic: Cluster 1: option put/call IV ratio momentum across 30/60/90d horizons. Bearish hedging -> reversal. Anchor alpha.
Cluster 2: long-horizon (720d) put-IV minus call-IV skew differential reversed. Long flat-skew, short steep-skew.
Cluster 2 alt: stacked long-horizon skews (180/360/720) reversed. Higher SH version; mutual 0.952 with Sk_h720.
Cluster 3: weighted blend 70% IV-mean term-structure (30/180+60/360+90/720) + 30% skew. Best A-diversifier (corr 0.258).
factors.expr: zscore(ts_decay_linear(add(multiply(0.8, zscore(reverse(zscore(divide(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_mean_10, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_mean_1080, 5)))))), multiply(0.2, zscore(reverse(add(add(zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_180, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_180, 5))), zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_360, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_360, 5)))), zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_720, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_720, 5)))))))), 10))

factors.economic: Cluster 3 alt: 60% term + 40% skew. Higher SH (1.88) but 0.961 within cluster.
factors.expr: zscore(ts_decay_linear(add(multiply(0.6, zscore(reverse(zscore(divide(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_mean_10, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_mean_1080, 5)))))), multiply(0.4, zscore(reverse(add(add(zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_180, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_180, 5))), zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_360, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_360, 5)))), zscore(subtract(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_put_720, 5), ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_720, 5)))))))), 10))
